_comment: D.7 Google Drive backup. Uploads run ONLY when enabled is true AND a service-account JSON exists at credentials_file (share your Drive folder with its client_email). chunk_size_mb must be a multiple of 0.25 (256 KiB quantum). Interrupted uploads persist in cache/drive_upload_state and resume automatically on the next render or via the Settings page button. drive_endpoints/mime_types are advanced overrides (endpoints exist for offline tests); leave them empty in production. See docs/DRIVE_UPLOAD.md.
